title: fix(research): require exact Git spelling for replay inputs
body:
## Summary

```diff
 metadata validation / replay planning
- accept a lexical input spelling that may not match Git's changed paths
+ require exact HEAD-tree spelling
+ retain exact removed paths so deletion and case-only renames select replay
```

Implements [PR2994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2994)'s repair handoff. One fresh NUL-delimited Git inventory is shared by each boundary's input checks. No filesystem case folding, Unicode normalization, mutable-index substitution or persistent cache. Untracked/staged-only inputs must be committed first; stale missing declarations fail rather than silently disappearing.

Adds nine behavioral groups, the documented contract, and a [source-bound replay package](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/3cb500b743f36e13d21b6a46f126846bf36bad32/research/replay-input-head-spelling). Started from canonical main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, priority revision 6, and refreshed unchanged before submission. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2983#discussioncomment-18978476). No selected frontier or frozen evidence changes.

## Evidence

- **Before:** SHA256/Git-blob-authenticated main emits a successful empty matrix for `SRC/dep.json`, `src/DEP.json` and `SRC/DEP.json` against an actual target-only commit. Canonical spelling selects exactly its consumer against the same diff.
  **After:** each alias fails before matrix/output publication; canonical, deleted-parent and both case-only-rename consumers remain correctly selected. Full metadata, Unicode spelling, embedded filename whitespace, staged/untracked inputs and Git errors have explicit controls.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes, including the source-bound before/after comparison and nine new plus five retained groups.
- Research-tooling suite: 167 tests run, 11 platform skips. All nine new groups also pass on optimized Python 3.12/3.13 with warnings treated as errors.
- Complete all-input planning accepts 1,136 registered packages. Selected-record, selected CI input/trigger and committed-byte checks pass. New-code Ruff passes; four unrelated existing shared-runner findings are unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/replay-input-head-spelling
```

Credit Arham Tahir/PR2994 for the native macOS counterexample and precise repair handoff; Nick Petalas/PR2986 and EdDiboi for the distinct symlink finding/repair; woklerx/PR1891, Charles Bethin, Douglas Colkitt and the retained runner/scaffold authors. New work by Nick Petalas, Apache-2.0. Existing attribution and scientific source pins remain intact.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** replay-selection

This intentionally tightens shared metadata/planning: inputs must be committed under their exact HEAD spelling, and the shared boundaries require a valid Git checkout. Shared-runner changes select all registered packages through existing CI policy. Standalone verifiers retain their own export contracts.

Linux execution only. Native macOS/Windows, hosted CI, independent human review and the selected cold supplier replay are not claimed. Distinct tracked names that physically alias, concurrent source mutation and hostile-repository resource limits remain outside scope. No new supplier, kappa or full multiplication theorem is claimed.
